Our delivery model for the Energy Department, Government of Punjab aligns team capability with disciplined quality assurance for multi-site design, supply, installation, testing and commissioning across operating hospital environments.

Certifications and management systems: We hold ISO 9001 quality management certification, evidenced through prior delivery under ISO 9001-governed engagements [CAP-030][CAP-022][CAP-039], supporting controlled processes for site surveys, engineering reviews, inspection/testing records, and nonconformance/corrective action. For governed delivery and configuration control across multiple locations, our library evidences CMMI Level 3-certified project execution on renewable and infrastructure programs [CAP-008][CAP-044][CAP-028]. Where SCADA/monitoring and information handling are in scope, our library also evidences ISO 27001-aligned delivery on federal and solar engagements [CAP-003][CAP-020].

Team capability: We have completed solar energy deployments for provincial government and federal government clients in Pakistan [CAP-008][CAP-020], and we bring direct experience executing projects for provincial and federal government entities [CAP-008][CAP-020][CAP-018][CAP-004]. We also evidence delivery in hospital contexts through hospital IT deployments for federal and provincial government clients [CAP-042][CAP-018].

For this assignment, we will staff (i) a PMP-certified Project Manager, (ii) Solar PV Design Lead, (iii) Site/Civil Lead, (iv) Electrical & Protection Lead, (v) QA/QC Engineer, and (vi) HSE Supervisor; our library evidences delivery under PMP-governed engagements [CAP-005][CAP-027].

Quality assurance: Our QA/QC will implement site-specific Inspection & Test Plans, design verification/peer reviews, and commissioning checklists aligned to the RFP’s requirements. Our library does not yet evidence IEC 62548 compliance documentation or an HSE policy specific to operational healthcare facilities; we will address this by submitting project-specific compliance matrices, method statements, and hospital-safe work plans for approval prior to mobilization.
